InviteApiData.description: Per-address invite outcome from the upstream BrowserStack invite API. Null when the caller lacks invite permission.

success.description: Overall invite success after 'already invited'/'already present' addresses are reclassified as non-errors.

data.description: Invite counts per product plus `emailErrors`, an array of {email, hasError, errorMsg} describing each address's outcome.

WebhookRuleLite.description: Summary form of a webhook rule as returned in list responses. Excludes payload headers/body and stored auth — fetch a single rule for those.

url.description: Target URL of the rule's payload.

eventType.description: One of build_finish, test_failure, qg_result, alert_trigger, test_case, test_plan, build, test_run.

WebhookRuleDetail.description: Full webhook rule definition (WebhookRuleDto). No data wrapper — the fields sit at the top level of the response.

projectId.description: Legacy single-project id; populated for a rule with no mapping rows (e.g. a project-scoped rule).

reTrigger.description: Re-trigger payload; null when not configured.

WebhookPayload.description: Outbound request definition for a webhook rule (and for the test call).

type.description: Payload template mode: default | custom | reuse.

auth.description: Target auth. On a stored rule this is returned by the single-rule read.

body.description: Arbitrary JSON body sent to the target.

WebhookEventRule.description: One condition on a webhook rule. Null-valued fields are omitted.

WebhookListInfo.description: Pagination envelope for the rule list; present only when the caller sent a page.

WebhookProjectMapping.description: Projects a rule is linked to, with pagination info. Hydrated from TestHub.

WebhookPaginationInfo.description: Project-picker / project-mapping pagination info (distinct from WebhookListInfo).

WebhookProjectInfoLite.description: A project row in the webhook project picker / mapping list.

isSelected.description: True when this project is already linked to the queried webhook rule.

AISessionToken.description: AI-service session token and feature flags returned by get_ai_session_token. On an upstream null / consent-declined path jwt_token is absent/empty and enabled_features is empty.

jwt_token.description: Short-lived AI-service JWT. Empty string on the pipeline-request short-circuit or when consent is declined.

enabled_features.description: Enabled AI feature slugs; empty array when none/consent declined.

ai_enabled.description: Per-user AI access override (CTO-5010), distinct from ai_opt_in_consent. null when the user has no explicit override; only an explicit false disables.

PresignedUpload.description: Presigned S3 browser-POST credential minted for a direct-to-S3 upload. Returned by the RCA-context, build-chat and code-fix presign calls. No file bytes cross this boundary.

uploadUrl.description: S3 endpoint to POST the file to.

formFields.description: Form fields to include verbatim in the multipart S3 POST.

s3Key.description: The key the object will occupy (an 'unconfirmed' prefix); quote this back when saving/retriggering.

RcaRetrigger.description: Result of retrigger_rca_analysis. Asynchronous — carries only the new turn's id and, for trial users, the quota used.

messageId.description: Id of the new RCA conversation turn; poll this for the refreshed analysis.

trialQuota.description: Present (non-null) only for test-level trial users; omitted otherwise.

CodeFixPreference.description: Saved AI code-fix guidance for a (project, buildName). Returned by get/create/update code-fix preference.

downloadUrl.description: Presigned GET URL for the file; present only when resolvable (omitted when null).

BuildAccessibilityMeta.description: Web/Automate build-level accessibility summary. Note: App-Automate builds with App Accessibility enabled are proxied and return a different shape.

totalIssue.description: Sum of the severity counts that were present.

severityBreakdown.description: Per-severity issue counts; only severities that were present are included.

autoEnabledBuild.description: Whether accessibility auto-scan was enabled for the build.

reportUrl.description: Deep link into the Accessibility dashboard (not an API endpoint).

count.description: The metric value (e.g. always-failing test count).

meta.description: Metric metadata, typically the total the count is out of.

presignedUrl.description: Presigned S3 URL to the report artefact; expires.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 expiry of the presigned URL.

summary.description: Narrative failure summary; null when status is NOT_AVAILABLE.

data.description: The alerts that fired for this build.

alertsConfigured.description: Whether the project has any alert rules configured at all.

WorkflowStatusAggregate.description: Per-workflow-status counts. Null-valued keys are omitted. Statuses use display-cased JSON keys.

otherCount.description: Counts for any non-standard statuses, keyed by status name.

summary.description: Aggregate across attempts (same fields as an attempt entry, without a label).

data.description: Per-build value of this status, aligned with the response `keys`.
One series per status.

keys.description: Build labels along the x-axis (order of the ~10 recent builds).

BuildOptimization.description: Null-valued fields are omitted from the response.

isLearningModeEnabled.description: From a live TCS lookup; ABSENT (not false) when TCS fails or when no uuid was supplied.

testOrchestration.description: Test-orchestration configuration blob from TestHub (opaque shape).

metadata.description: Build summary metadata for the split.
Build summary metadata for the group.

retryData.description: Re-run groups, each with per-split breakdowns.

FilterField.description: A single selectable filter option. `id`/`value` are what you send back as the filter selection; `label` is the display text. For branch/tag options all three are the raw value; for user/team options `id` is the numeric id (stringified) and value/label are the name.

count.description: Match count for this option; usually null on these facet lists.

pId.description: Optional parent-id grouping token; empty string on these lists.

BuildFilterStatic.description: Static catalogue of selectable build-listing filter options. Each list is the full menu of choices, not a presence list.

BuildFilterApplied.description: The caller's applied build-listing filter, echoed back in resolved form (ids turned into name-bearing objects).

FilterStruct__w2_build_filter1.description: A static test-filter option: a display label and the value to send back. `pId` is present only for hierarchical options (e.g. folder trees).

Dashboard.description: A custom dashboard's full definition, as returned under `data` by the dashboard read/create/update/clone endpoints.

MetaItem.description: An id resolved to its display name.

errorClusterId.description: Stable id of the unique-error cluster.

FilterDetails.description: A custom field offered as a dashboard widget filter.

type.description: Filter type: Basic or Custom (always Custom on this route).

DashboardPageInfo.description: Pagination cursor for the paginated widget-custom-field-filters response.

ReportSummary.description: One row of the reports/dashboards listing. Many fields are conditionally present (external-integration and project fields only appear for scheduled/linked reports).

id.description: Dashboard/report id (UUID or numeric depending on row).

ReportListPageInfo.description: Pagination cursor for the reports listing.

TakeAwayMetric.description: A single Home takeaway metric: current value and the previous-window value.

TakeAwayMetricV2.description: A v2 failure-noise category: absolute count and its percentage of total failures.

reduction.description: This category as a percentage of totalFailures (for uniqueErrors it is the complementary reduction).

TakeAwayData.description: Home key-takeaway cards, each metric comparing the current 7 days to the prior 7 days.

TimeSavingMetric.description: Aggregate time-saved breakdown returned by the older Home takeaways variant.

TimeSavingV2Metric.description: v2 failure-noise breakdown returned by the newer Home takeaways variant. When totalFailures is 0 the per-category objects are omitted.

ProjectExternal.description: A project as exposed by the public/external API.

created_by.description: User id of the project owner.

observability_url.description: Ready-made deep link to the project's builds page.

ExternalPagination.description: Cursor pagination envelope for the external API.

has_next.description: True whenever the current page was non-empty; the final full page is followed by one empty page.

next_page.description: Opaque base64 cursor to pass as next_page for the following page.

RecentView.description: One recently-viewed item on the Home page.

AlertType.description: A subscribable alert type from the account-wide reference catalogue.

id.description: Alert type id; the value create_project_alert_by_integer_id takes as alertTypeId.

AlertRuleResource.description: A single threshold/condition rule on the older alert surface.

AlertNotifierResource.description: A notification target attached to (or attachable to) an alert.

AlertResource.description: An alert as returned inside the project settings payload (older surface shape).

notificationRules.description: Map keyed by notifier type (SLACK / EMAIL) → channel-key → list of AlertNotifierResource.

IssueSubTypeResource.description: A custom failure-category sub-type as returned in the project settings payload.

locator.description: String id used to update/delete this sub-type.

Notifier.description: An available notification target (Slack channel / email) for a project.

value.description: Opaque JSON blob holding the channel / email detail; shape depends on `type`.

GlobalUserPreference.description: A signed-in user's cross-project UI preferences, rewritten per product on read.

buildDetailsTabPreferences.description: Ordered build-details tabs; array order is tab order.

defaultTabForRunningBuilds.description: Null on rows written before OB-10619; read as 'sessions'.

RcaConversationTurn.description: One RCA conversation turn. Used by both the test-run flow (AIController / ExternalAIController) and the build-level chat flow (BuildRcaConversationController), from the same RcaConversationResponse DTO. threadId, threadTitle and userAction carry values ONLY in the build-level flow; in the test-run flow they are always null. metadata is a sanitised projection.

threadId.description: Owning build-chat thread. Populated in the build flow (always set on a create reply, including lazy-create); null in the test-run flow.

threadTitle.description: Server-derived thread title (<=60 chars from the first user message). Build flow only; null before the first message, and null in the test-run flow.

userMessage.description: The user's typed instruction for this turn (may be null for a pure workflow-action turn).

userAction.description: Structured workflow-card action the turn was submitted with. Build flow only; null for plain message turns and in the test-run flow.

assistantMessage.description: The agent's answer payload (arbitrary JSON). Null until the turn reaches COMPLETED.

metadata.description: Sanitised metadata: at most thinking_data (agent narration) and user_approval (accepted/discarded). Model/provider/token/cost/raw-failure fields are stripped and never returned. Null when there is nothing to expose.

userAttachments.description: Attachments the user sent with the turn.

RcaAttachment.description: A user attachment on an RCA conversation turn (from AttachmentResponse).

BuildRcaThread.description: A build-level RCA chat thread (from BuildRcaThreadResponse), scoped to one (build, user).

title.description: Null until the first user message sets it.

Field.description: A filter option / type-ahead suggestion item as returned across the Suite Health filter routes.

id.description: Stable identifier for the option (often equal to value).

value.description: The raw value to send back when applying this option as a filter.

count.description: Occurrence count; null on suggestion routes that do not compute it.

pId.description: Parent id, used for hierarchical options (e.g. folders); empty when not applicable.

t.description: Secondary timestamp/marker for the bucket; may be null.

y.description: Value at the bucket (count, average, or percentage depending on the series); null when the series has no value for this bucket.

pointRange.description: The [start, end] epoch-ms span the bucket covers (present on the failure-rate series).

SPChart.description: A Suite Health chart: named data series plus a summary insight.

data.description: Map of series name -> array of TimelineDataPoint. Series keys depend on the chart (e.g. totalExecutions/totalFailures, averageDuration, averageFailureRates).

value.description: Formatted headline value, e.g. '12/340' or '3.5%' or '02m 10s'.

meta.description: Optional secondary text; null when not set.

SPTestBreakdownRow.description: One environment (OS/browser/device) row in a test's stability breakdown.

reliability.description: Failure percentage (failed*100/total), 2 decimals; 0 when there were no executions.

browser.description: Formatted browser descriptor, with a nested `device` field.

browserDevice.description: Alternate browser descriptor carrying the full device object.

status.description: 'success', or 'failure' (with empty logs) when Loki reported a non-success status.

appLogQuery.description: The echoed Loki query parameters the service built from the run.

groups.description: Group (tenant) ids the query was scoped to.

logs.description: Flat, timestamp-sorted app-log lines (abnormal/error level only). Empty on a clean run or a Loki non-success.

app.description: App name from the Loki stream.

level.description: Log level; 'unknown' when Loki did not tag a level.

epochNano.description: Timestamp in epoch nanoseconds; the list is sorted ascending by this.

line.description: Log text after the ' cSep=S ' separator; the raw line when the separator is absent.

LogUrls.description: Test-run log bundle as URLs plus metadata (from /ext/v1/testRun/{id}/logs and the v2 consolidated-logs route).

SessionLogs.description: Per-type session log artefacts (URLs / nodes). Null-valued types are omitted (JsonInclude NON_NULL).

SessionNetwork.description: A session's network (HAR) log artefact pointer.

SessionNetworkLogUrlResponse.description: Envelope returned by /api/v1/sessions/{sessionId}/networkLogs (unparsed form): the HAR URL plus fetch status.

networkLogs.description: URL of the session's HAR network log file (NOT the parsed entries).

SessionLogsResponse.description: Session consolidated-logs response: per-type log URLs plus framework and any failure logs.

browserstackLogs.description: Per-type session log URLs; empty SessionLogs when the log fetch failed (swallowed).

failureLogs.description: Populated only when the session was manually marked failed with a reason.

GenericLog.description: One log entry in a merged/consolidated log stream. Null fields are omitted (JsonInclude NON_NULL).

content.description: Inline log text (present because content is merged server-side).

url.description: URL for entries backed by an external artefact rather than inline content.

duration.description: Duration in seconds, formatted to 2 decimals.

TestDetailResponse.description: Per-hook (or per-test) detail bundle: its test code, opaque metadata and any hook code.

testCode.description: The test's source code / file info.

TestCodeResponse.description: A test's source code and location.

url.description: VCS URL to the file, built from the run's VCS info.

TestRunCode.description: Captured source for a test or hook run. code/language are null when nothing was captured for that run; the row is still returned.

TestRunDetail.description: Full detail of a single test run: its captured code, its metadata, and the code of the hooks that ran around it.

testMetadata.description: Metadata for the run. In get_test_run_details this is the internal test-meta object (broad, includes history/RCA/test-case links); in the baseline and similar-error MAP reads it is a flatter meta object (type, testName, status [lowercased], buildId, issueType, device/cbtBrowser/cbtPlatform, scopes, isFlaky/isNewFailure/isAlwaysFailing). Read keys off the actual response.

hooksCode.description: Code of before/after hooks related to this run. Present on get_test_run_details; absent from the map reads.

BuildInsights.description: Build-level failure/flakiness insights surrounding a test run.

failureContext.description: Per-run failure context: file and parent-module failure rates for the run under inspection.

status.description: ANALYSIS_PENDING | ANALYSIS_COMPLETE | ANALYSIS_NOT_STARTED. uniqueErrors may be empty/partial unless COMPLETE.

truncatedError.description: First ~200 chars of the error for a quick overview.

TestRunAttachmentUrls.description: A page of presigned attachment/screenshot download URLs for one test run. URLs expire ~2h after issue.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token; null on the last page. Pass back as `cursor`.

BuildTestRunWithAttachments.description: Trimmed test-run row for the 'runs having attachments' discovery listing.

FlatTestRun.description: One row of the flat build test-run listing. Top-level `id` is the test HASH (string); the numeric run id is `details.id`.

id.description: Test hash, NOT the numeric run id.

VcsCheckMapping.description: A vcs_ingestion row: a PR check registered against a check configuration for evaluation. Serialised directly from the JPA entity (no wrapper).

id.description: Ingestion row id — the id used by get_checks_mapping.

callbackUrl.description: URL the evaluation pipeline calls back with results.

checkStates.description: Evaluation state; newly created rows are 'Not Started'.

checkType.description: QG_STATUS or BUILD_STATUS, copied from the matched check configuration.

userId.description: Owner user id, copied from the matched check configuration.

commitTimestamp.description: Parsed from pr_data.date; may be unset when the date was omitted.

prMetadataJson.description: The pr_data object stored verbatim, with githubCheckId merged in.

thProjectId.description: Target project id, copied from the matched check configuration.

buidlParentId.description: Build parent id (field is spelled 'buidlParentId' in the payload); typically null at creation.

CheckConfigurationEntity.description: A checks_configuration row as embedded inside a vcs_ingestion mapping (the raw JPA entity, camelCase fields).

CheckConfigurationItem.description: A single check-run configuration as returned by the check-runs endpoints (CheckConfigurationItemResponse).

checkId.description: Check-configuration id — the id used in the update/toggle/delete path.

projectId.description: Resolved BrowserStack project id for projectName.

View.description: A saved view (filters row) as returned by the view endpoints.

type.description: Screen type code: 1 builds, 2 testRuns, 3 testHealth, 4 uniqueErrors, 5 buildInsights.

query.description: The stored serialised filter.

description.description: Optional free-text description; typically null (not settable through create/update).

createdBy.description: Creator user id (from the session, not the body).

groupId.description: Owning group id (from the session, not the body).

DashboardView.description: A dashboard view as returned by the dashboards/views read, create, update and clone endpoints (the object under the response `data` key).

filters.description: Global dashboard filters (DashboardFilters): dateRange, tags, buildTags, folders, projects, buildName, branches, users, lastExecutedBy, teams, tcmTestPlanIds, match, source, includeManualAndAutomated, and TM display fields.

widgets.description: Widget layout (Widgets objects: id, name, type, globalFilters, desc, config, layout).

totalWidget.description: Count of widgets on the dashboard.

isDefault.description: True for the built-in default dashboard (date range then forced to last 30 days).

isAutomation.description: True for the built-in automation-trend dashboard.

WidgetCatalogueEntry.description: One entry in the addable-widget catalogue (WidgetDetails).

key.description: WidgetTypeEnum value to use as a widget's `type`.

CustomFieldFilterDetail.description: A custom (user-defined) test-case field usable as a dashboard-widget filter (FilterDetails).

LogRedactionRule.description: A single log-redaction rule as returned by the log-redaction endpoints.

id.description: Integer rule id, used in update/delete/reorder.

pattern.description: The RE2J regex whose matches are replaced with [MASKED].

description.description: Optional human note; may be null.

enabled.description: Whether the rule currently masks ingested logs.

PatternRule.description: A single failure-pattern rule as returned by the pattern-rules endpoints (issueType exposed as a locator, not a numeric id).

id.description: Integer pattern-rule id (from the TestHub backend), used in update/delete.

pattern.description: RE2J regex matched against failure messages.

issueType.description: Issue-type locator the match is tagged with (translated from the backend numeric id).

LogRedactionTestLineResult.description: Per-line result of a redaction pattern dry-run.

matched.description: Whether the pattern matched this line at least once.

matchCount.description: Number of matches (substitutions) on this line.

RepoDetail.description: One linked source-repository entry within a repo configuration. Serialized with non-null fields only, so absent optional fields are omitted from the wire.

type.description: Role of this entry, e.g. test-code vs application-code. The test-type entry carries `custom_prompt`.

folder_path.description: Sub-path within the repo scoped for scanning.

custom_prompt.description: Custom steering prompt persisted on the test-type entry after a generation call is accepted.

RepoSettingListItem.description: Summary row for one repo configuration in the list response. Does NOT include repo_details — read one configuration by build name (or by id via other calls) for the full entries.

test_repo_count.description: Number of test-type repo entries in this configuration.

test_repo_name.description: Name of the primary test repo, for display.

RepoSettingDetail.description: Full repo configuration returned by create/read-by-build-name/update, including its repo entries.

SmartTagSettings.description: A project's smart-tag detection thresholds. Serialized with camelCase keys and no wrapper envelope.

flippingCount.description: Must be strictly less than consecutiveRuns.

ReportRecord.description: A saved report (the DashboardsData shape; reports and dashboards share it). Nulls are included. Widgets for a report-typed record are under `reports`; for a dashboard-typed record under `widgets`.

widgets.description: Widget list for a dashboard-typed record; empty for a report-typed one.

reports.description: Widget list for a report-typed record.

TestRunReportRow.description: One row in a tabular test-runs report dataset OR one build row in the static-builds listing (the same TestRunReport class, populated differently per endpoint). A large flat row; only representative fields are listed. For datasets these are test-run rows (testName, status, flakiness, customFields, …); for static-builds these are build rows (buildId, buildName, buildNumber, displayStatus, buildStartedAt, workflowStatusStats, …).

PaginationSummary.description: Paging summary for report datasets/builds. totalDatasets is -1 on these routes (not a real total); page using hasNext.

StatTile.description: One aggregate stat tile: a metric key and its value.

meta.description: Metric key, e.g. totalUniqueTests, flakyTestsCount, totalPassedExecutions.

ReportCustomFieldItem.description: A custom-field / column definition usable in a report.

entityType.description: TestCase or TestExecution — the only thing distinguishing two same-named fields.

ReportTestStats.description: Headline stats for one test in the tabular report. An empty object `{}` is returned when the test has no matching runs.

reliability.description: Failure ratio as a percentage: failed*100/total.

ReportTrendDataPoint.description: One point in a test's trend series. Null fields are omitted.

color.description: Colour derived from the workflow status.

ReportTestTrendResponse.description: Per-run trend series for one test.

TabularReportRow.description: One row of the tabular test-runs report as built by the report handler (only the fields this path populates).

smartTagSettings.description: Present only for builds newer than the applied schema date.

TabularTestRunsReportResponse.description: Paginated tabular test-runs report page. Empty result returns null data and null summary.

totalDatasets.description: -1 on these routes (not a real total).

paginatedResults.description: Count of rows on this page.

hasNext.description: True when the page came back full.

ReportStatTilesResponse.description: Summary tiles for the tabular report.

data.description: Tiles. Empty/absent when all datasets conflict or no stats were returned.

meta.description: Tile name (e.g. totalUniqueTests). Note the key is `meta`, not `name`.

WidgetFilterValueList.description: Flat list of values for one widget filter key.

WidgetEnhancedFilterResponse.description: Widget filter values bucketed with paging cursors.

data.description: Map keyed by bucket (e.g. suggested / others); each value is a list of filter-value structs.

suggestedAfterKey.description: Cursor to continue the suggested bucket.

othersAfterKey.description: Cursor to continue the others bucket.

WidgetDrillDownData.description: Row-level records behind a widget data point.

data.description: Drill-down rows. Each carries project identity (projectId, thProjectId, projectName, normalisedName) plus widget-specific fields.

summary.description: Per-product SummaryDetails; present only when a product was supplied.

data.description: Running builds in the standard build-summary shape (uuid, id, name, status, duration, startedAt, projectId, tags, statusStats, ...).

DeviceTierUsageInfo.description: Aggregated mobile device-tier usage and device list for a product. Both fields are raw JSON trees from the backend.

tierInfo.description: Per-tier device/parallel limits and current usage (mobile tiers only).

TestExecutionUsageCount.description: Execution counts for a window. NOTE: when both userId and groupId are missing the endpoint instead returns the plain string 'Missing userId or groupId'.

totalTestCount.description: All tests reported in the window.

browserstackTestCount.description: Subset that ran on BrowserStack infra (carry a sessionId).

GroupPlanUsageDetails.description: Plan info/details plus non-BrowserStack usage figures. All counts are compacted display strings (e.g. '1.2K'). Usage fields are null when the group has no execution limit; the null-branch uses `nonBrowserstackTestExecutions` in place of `nonBrowserstackUsedTestExecutions`.

nonBrowserstackTestExecutions.description: Null-branch key only (when no execution limit).

billingResetDate.description: Epoch millis; null when no limit.

ShareReportEmailResponse.description: Outcome of a report share. Read `success`, not the HTTP status.

status.description: HttpStatus name, e.g. OK / BAD_REQUEST / INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.

invite_api_data.description: Per-recipient invite detail (null when unauthorized to invite).

data.description: Invite data including per-email errors.

GlobalSearchEntity.description: One search result. Concrete shape is per-type (Build / BuildTestCaseExecutionResult / Project), discriminated by `entity`.

GlobalSearchResult.description: Search results. pagingParams and totalCount are omitted in overlay mode.

CreateHealingPrResponse.description: Self-healing PR job state. At create time only healingPrId + status are set (status=IN_PROGRESS); the remaining fields are populated by the background worker and read back via the status endpoint.

status.description: One of IN_PROGRESS, SUCCEEDED, PARTIAL, FAILED, NO_CHANGES_NEEDED.

prUrl.description: URL of the opened PR; null until a terminal PR-producing state.

headSha.description: Head commit SHA of the PR branch; null until committed.

perFileReport.description: Per-file applied/skipped detail (arbitrary JSON); present on terminal outcomes.

errorMessage.description: Failure detail; present on FAILED/PARTIAL outcomes.

HealingVerdictResponse.description: A recorded verdict on one AI-healed locator.

elementHash.description: Hash keying the healed element (used to join with the healing report).

healedLocator.description: The healed locator that was judged (arbitrary JSON node, e.g. {type, value}).

feedback.description: Optional free-form feedback (arbitrary JSON); null when none.

isCarryover.description: True when this verdict was first recorded against an earlier build.

carryoverBuildSerialId.description: The earlier build's serial id when isCarryover is true.

BuildComparisonAggregation.description: Headline counts for a base-vs-target build comparison. On a fenced (cross-source) pair all counts are 0 and sourceFencingFlags is set.

BuildComparisonAvailable.description: Comparison availability pre-check. On a fenced pair only sourceFencingFlags is set (status/message null).

BuildComparisonStringEnvelope.description: base/target build UUIDs resolved to their parent builds.

base.description: Resolved parent build UUID for the base side.

target.description: Resolved parent build UUID for the target side.

BuildComparisonMetaEnvelope.description: The two build summary headers, base and target. On a fenced pair base/target are null and sourceFencingFlags is set. Status counts are AMR-corrected.

BuildComparisonList.description: One comparison bucket's tests, grouped for display. Fenced pairs return an empty groups list with sourceFencingFlags set.

BuildComparisonListGroup.description: A file/environment grouping of compared tests.

BuildComparisonListGroupScopeElement.description: One compared test's detail on one side.

Comment.description: A comment as returned by create_comment. Carries the sanitised HTML under `content`.

content.description: Sanitised HTML body (this is where the request's commentHtml lands).

CommentRes.description: A comment as returned by the comment list reads. Note it carries `commentNode` but NOT the `content` HTML.

BuildRunComment.description: A comment-thread summary for the build-level side panel.

SPFilterField.description: A single filter option / labelled value used across the Unique Errors filter surface.

id.description: Option key (for OS/browser the comma-encoded value is turned into an underscore id).

value.description: Backing value; usually equal to id for tags/branches.

count.description: Occurrence count for the option; frequently null on typeahead results.

pId.description: Parent grouping key (JSON key is `pId`), often an empty string.

UniqueErrorClusterRow.description: One error cluster row in the unique-errors list (serialised ErrorResult).

id.description: The errorClusterId as a numeric string — the cluster id to pass as errorId / clusterId to the detail views.

impactedTests.description: Distinct tests affected by this error (cardinality of stabilityHash).

errorCount.description: Total occurrences of the error in the window.

chartData.description: Per-day occurrence counts (no timestamps; one bucket per calendar day over the window).

error.description: Sample error text split on newlines into lines.

UniqueErrorImpactedTest.description: One impacted test in an error-cluster breakdown (serialised ErrorTests).

id.description: Stability hash (test signature), not a numeric id.

filePath.description: Source file path; may be null.

browsers.description: Browser objects (each with a formatted browser label and a `device`).

errorCount.description: Occurrences of the error for this test.

testRunId.description: A representative failing run id; may be null.

UniqueErrorBuild.description: One build in which a unique error occurred (serialised ErrorBuild). Several derived fields are exposed only via getters.

ciBuildData.description: CI info; null when the build has none.

isFailedWithSameError.description: True when this build's run failed with THIS exact cluster.

pmToolDetails.description: Linked PM-tool (Jira etc.) entries; empty array when none.

smartTagSettings.description: Smart-tag settings applied to the build; may be null.

issueType.description: Getter-derived {isAutoAnalyzed, value}; null unless the run status is failed.

SPTimelineDataPoint.description: One point in a Suite Health chart series.

SPChart__w3_sp_error.description: A Suite Health chart: one or more named series plus a headline insight.

data.description: Single-entry map from series name to a list of points. The series name differs per chart (totalUniqueErrors / uniqueImpactedTests / totalImpactedTests).

value.description: Headline total, formatted as a STRING.

TestRunsRcaData.description: The stored AI RCA for a test run. Peek-only fields (pendingMessageId, alreadyTracked, isLive) and NON_NULL fields (failureTypeDisplayName, conversation, trialQuota) appear only when set. rcaData/thinkingData are opaque model output populated once state is Completed.

rcaData.description: Opaque generated analysis; populated when state is Completed, otherwise typically null.

bulkRcaId.description: UUID linking runs analysed together via a bulk RCA request; null for a singly-generated RCA.

isAgentic.description: Whether this RCA used the agentic flow. Forced false for LTS-product callers.

isMcpDriven.description: True when the RCA is owned by the MCP-powered chat agent (the web composer is then disabled).

pendingMessageId.description: Peek-only: messageId of the in-flight PENDING conversation row, if any.

alreadyTracked.description: Peek-only: whether a build-chat row already tracks pendingMessageId. Null for web/MCP-started generations.

isLive.description: Peek-only: true when a generation is genuinely running right now — the field to gate a re-trigger on.

conversation.description: Present only for a chat-driven RCA turn.

trialQuota.description: Present only for trial users; carries used-quota info.

BuildGroup.description: A run group (build group). Serialized with non-null fields only; `state` is computed (ACTIVE until closed, then CLOSED).

project_id.description: TestHub project id the group belongs to.

ReleaseReadinessSummary.description: Compact Release Readiness report projection. Reused by /summary, flattened (unwrapped) into /prs and /workflows, and returned inline by /trigger on a cache-hit. All fields are NON_NULL (omitted when absent). On a non-completed build only `state` (+ `failureReason` on FAILED) is present.

state.description: Lifecycle state: COMPLETED | IN_PROGRESS | FAILED | NOT_STARTED.

generatedAt.description: Report-generation identity, passed through verbatim; omitted on old blobs and on status-only IN_PROGRESS/FAILED summaries.

failureReason.description: Bounded reason string, present only on a FAILED state.

prs.description: Inline PR lens detail on a COMPLETED summary; null on an in-progress summary.

workflows.description: Inline workflow lens detail on a COMPLETED summary; null on an in-progress summary.

verdict.description: Rule-based (NOT AI) build verdict derived by obs-api: 'partial-go' when there is >=1 suspect PR, 'go' only for a COMPLETED report with no suspects, absent otherwise.

faultyPrNumbers.description: Revert list — the PR numbers of every suspect PR.

workflowsState.description: Build-level workflows readiness, passed through verbatim: AVAILABLE | PENDING | UNAVAILABLE. Legacy reports without it resolve to AVAILABLE.

verdictProvisional.description: True when workflowsState == PENDING — the verdict is not yet final.

ReleaseReadinessPrEntry.description: A pull request the report attributed build failures to. All fields NON_NULL.

confidence.description: Confidence band: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'. Never null — defaults to 'medium' when the agent did not grade the PR.

ReleaseReadinessWorkflowEntry.description: A CI workflow/theme implicated in the build's failures. All fields NON_NULL.

workflowData.description: Opaque TestHub workflow metadata, passed through unchanged.

themeData.description: Opaque TestHub theme metadata, passed through unchanged.

SplitBuildLegs.description: Split-build legs payload built by BuildService.getSplitBuildDetails (a ProjectDto subset). Only the fields this render actually populates are described.

id.description: Observability project id the split build belongs to.

builds.description: The child legs, each a full build-summary object (same shape as BuildDetails).

PagingParams.description: Cursor pagination envelope. `searchAfter` is a build uuid (or list) to pass back as the next cursor; `hasNext` says whether another page exists.

nextRoot.description: Opaque next-root cursor map (composite-agg paging); may be null.

searchAfter.description: Either a list of cursor tokens (build uuids) or a single integer, depending on the endpoint.

BuildDetails.description: Full single-build detail object (BuildSummary DTO). Large flat object; only the non-obvious / gating fields are described. `vcsInfo` is write-only and never serialised.

status.description: Live/computed status; may reflect an in-flight aggregation mid-run.

displayStatus.description: Settled pipeline verdict; prefer this over `status` for the final outcome.

duration.description: Consolidated duration when present, else raw duration (the getter resolves this).

showHealingReport.description: UI gate: whether a self-healing report exists to show (S3 key-existence check).

showAuthoringReport.description: UI gate: whether an authoring-agent report exists (S3 check); forced true on demo-sandbox envs.

appAccessibilityEnabled.description: Per-group feature flag; fails CLOSED (false) if the flag lookup errors.

tcmTestPlans.description: Cross-product test-management plan links, if any.

BuildNotificationSummary.description: Compact build-summary email/notification card (BuildSummaryEmail DTO). `startedAt` is @JsonIgnore; the payload exposes formatted date/time/duration helpers instead. `accessibility` is present only for APP_ALLY_AUT builds.

displayStatus.description: Computed display status derived from status + statusStats.

colorMapping.description: Map of status/category -> hex color for rendering the card.

accessibility.description: APP_ALLY_AUT builds only; omitted (NON_NULL) otherwise. Populated fail-open.

BuildStabilityTile.description: Stability tile for a build (BuildStability DTO). `count` on the DTO is @JsonIgnore; the surfaced number lives in `overview.count`.

data.description: Per-run stability display series.

count.description: Current stability as a formatted percentage string (e.g. '92.3').

insights.description: Positive/negative/default verdict vs recent builds; only populated with >= 10 comparison runs.

BuildSummaryStats.description: Headline test-count strip for a build (BuildSummaryStats DTO).

data.description: Colored metric tiles (total/passed/failed/skipped/pending roll-ups).

hooksVisibility.description: Whether hook rows are shown/hidden for this project.

data.description: One chart series per status (passed/failed/running).
Array of [time, value] point pairs.

BuildFailureCategoryStats.description: Failure-category (defect) breakdown (DefectStats DTO). On a PENDING build, `data` is empty and `message` explains why (still HTTP 200).

message.description: Set to a 'available after your build finishes' notice while pending; otherwise typically absent.

name.description: Serialised from the DTO's `label` field via @JsonProperty("name").

value.description: Count of failures in this category.

ColoredMetric.description: A single colored metric tile / bucket.

name.description: Serialised from the DTO's `label` field via @JsonProperty("name").

BuildFailuresByModule.description: Failures grouped by test module / file path (FailureByModuleStats DTO).

parent.description: Parent node id for tree reconstruction.

customPathSplit.description: Path split by the inferred separator.

sourceFencingFlags.description: Present (NON_NULL) only when source-fencing excludes the build's product; names which products' tests were skipped.

BuildFilterValues.description: Older compact build-filter shape (FilterValues DTO): a single `filters` map keyed by facet name.

filters.description: Map keyed by facet (browser, os, issueType, tags, status, folder, history, flaky). Each value is a list of options. `history` and `flaky` are static option lists always present.

BuildTestFolders.description: Build test-listing folder tree. Two shapes depending on folder_path: root-folders (RootFoldersResponse) or folder-detail (FolderDetailsResponse). Both are @JsonInclude(NON_NULL). Fields from both are shown; only one branch's fields are populated per call.

folders.description: ROOT branch only: the root folders.

name.description: DETAIL branch only: the folder's name (last path segment).

folder_path.description: DETAIL branch only: full folder path.

cases_count.description: DETAIL branch: unique cases directly in this folder.

total_cases_count.description: DETAIL branch: unique cases including nested subfolders.

after_key.description: ROOT branch composite-agg cursor field; observed returned as null — page via pagingParams instead.

SubFolderDetails.description: One folder node in the build's test-listing tree (NON_NULL).

BuildNonSdkTestCounts.description: IMPORTANT: the body is a JSON *string* (Gson JsonObject.toString()), not a JSON object. After parsing the string it is `{untitled_test_count:int, unmarked_test_count:int, missing_failure_reason_count:int}`, counts spanning the parent build and its split child builds.

StatusAggregate.description: Test-status roll-up (NON_NULL). Keys are lower-case status names.

IssueTypeAggregate.description: Issue-type roll-up (NON_NULL). Keys are the human-readable issue-type labels, not camelCase.

completedCount.description: How many failures already have AI RCA completed.

pId.description: Serialised from the DTO's `pid` field via @JsonProperty("pId").

SingleMetricSummary__w4_build2.description: Shared single-metric tile (SingleMetricSummary DTO) used by the flaky / muted / new-failure tiles.

count.description: The metric count (flaky / muted / new-failure depending on endpoint).

meta.description: Context string, typically the 'out of N total' text.

autoUnmuteCount.description: Most meaningful for the muted tile; how many are scheduled to auto-unmute.

data.description: Individual alert entries.

BuildReportPresignedUrl.description: Presigned-URL link map returned by the build report endpoints (authoring / self-healing). The report artifact itself is fetched from presignedUrl, outside this API.

presignedUrl.description: Short-lived presigned S3 GET URL for the report file.

expiresAt.description: ISO-8601 instant at which presignedUrl stops working.

ExternalBuildDetails.description: Single external build-details object returned by get_latest_build. Fields are further plan-gated by the external JsonView wrapper (v1 BuildDetails / V2 variant selected by the new-build-listing flag), so some fields may be omitted for the account's plan.

statusStats.description: Per-status aggregate counts for the build.

ExternalProjectBuildListing.description: Public-API build listing (BuildListingResponse / BuildListingResponseV2, selected by the new-build-listing group flag). Top-level shape is identical across versions; only the per-build item shape differs.

builds.description: Newest-first. v1 items (BuildExternal) carry statusStats; V2 items (BuildExternalV2) replace it with workflowStatusStats and add isManuallyOverridden.

observabilityUrl.description: Deep link to the build in the TRA UI.

statusStats.description: v1 items only — per-status aggregate counts.

nextPage.description: Opaque base64 cursor for the next page; pass back as the next_page query param.

ProjectBuildListing.description: Internal build-listing payload (ProjectDto) returned by list_project_builds. builds[] are full BuildSummary objects.

builds.description: Rich BuildSummary rows (uuid, id, name, status, statusStats, duration, session/run counts, tags, qualityGateStatus, isArchived, displayStatus, parallelsUsed, tcmTestRunIdentifier, ...).

pagingParams.description: Cursor paging state (hasNext + searchAfter) for the next page.

BulkCloseResult.description: Acknowledgement returned by bulk_close_builds. Asynchronous — success is always true.

success.description: Always true; symmetric with bulk-archive. Not a per-build result.

jobId.description: Identifier of the async close job.

RunningBuildsOnDevice.description: Builds currently queued/running on a device+OS combination (PQRunningBuildsResponse). Empty data list when nothing matches.

data.description: BuildSummary rows for pending builds on the combination; each carries parallelsUsed (unique parallel sessions consumed).

parallelsUsed.description: Number of unique parallel sessions this build is consuming on the device+OS combination.

BuildInsights__w4_build4.description: Agent-oriented build failure summary returned by get_build_insights (BuildInsightsResponse).

failureContext.description: ALWAYS null on this build-keyed route (no test run supplied). Present only on the test-run variant: { file:{path,testCount,failedCount,failureRate}, parentModule:{...} }.

status.description: ANALYSIS_PENDING | ANALYSIS_COMPLETE | ANALYSIS_NOT_STARTED. uniqueErrors may be empty until COMPLETE.

truncatedError.description: First ~200 chars of the error only.

ProjectWithAggregates.description: A project enriched with Elasticsearch-derived build activity aggregates, as returned by the aggregate project-list routes.

buildCount.description: Distinct build count for the project in the caller's product context.

projectStability.description: Aggregate stability score for the project.

stabilityChartData.description: Series of stability values for a mini chart.

lastRanAt.description: When the project's most recent build finished.

lastRanBy.description: User id who triggered the most recent build.

IssueSubTypeResourceV2.description: A custom failure sub-category on the normalized-name settings surface. Distinct from IssueSubTypeResource (older surface): here `id` is the STRING locator and the parent is `category`, with no separate abbreviation field.

id.description: String locator of the sub-category — the value update_failure_category_sub_type and the sub-category DELETE take as `id`.

category.description: Parent failure-category key this sub-category hangs under.

FailureCategoryDisplayName.description: A built-in failure category with its per-project display-name override.

issueTypeId.description: Numeric issue-type id — the value update_failure_category_display_names takes as issueTypeId.

displayName.description: The project's custom label; falls back to `name` when no override is set, so it is never blank on read.

locator.description: String locator of the built-in category.

AlertResourceV2.description: An alert on the normalized-name settings surface — the same shape create_project_alert / update_project_alert take, plus the stored integer id.

id.description: Alert id. Pass this as `id` in update_project_alert's body to edit this alert (the update then returns a NEW id).

alertType.description: Alert-type key (buildStability / buildPerformance / flakinessPercentage / mutedDays / numberOfAlwaysFailingTests / spanOfAlwaysFailingTests).

alertRules.description: Map keyed by severity level (CRITICAL / WARNING) -> {value, condition}.

notificationRules.description: Map keyed by notifier type (SLACK / EMAIL) -> channel-key -> list of notifier mappings.

SuiteHealthTestListItem.description: One test row in the Stability & Performance / Suite/Test Health listing (com.browserstack.observability.models.response.SuiteHealth.TestStabilityAndPerformance).

id.description: The test's stabilityHash — the identifier to carry into the detail endpoints (serialized from testHash via @JsonProperty("id")).

isPlatformError.description: True when the sampled run's error was a platform (infra) error.

browserList.description: Browser/device combinations the test ran on.

platformList.description: OS/platform combinations the test ran on.

browsers.description: Always EMPTY on this listing path (populated only when the internal browserString is set, which this path never sets). Read browserList instead.

platforms.description: Always EMPTY on this listing path. Read platformList instead.

SuiteHealthPlatformBreakdownItem.description: One OS/browser/device row of a test's platform breakdown (TestStabilityAndPerformanceBreakdown).

reliability.description: Failure percentage for this combination (higher = worse).

duration.description: Average run duration for this combination.

browser.description: Browser display object with device as a plain string.

browserDevice.description: Browser display object with device as a nested object.

SuiteHealthTrendPoint.description: One execution point in the Suite Health trend series (TrendDataPoint, @JsonInclude NON_NULL — null fields are omitted).

SuiteHealthTestRun.description: One test execution in the Suite Health run-history table (TestStabilityAndPerformanceDetails). Smart-tag flags are under historyAggregate, not top-level.

name.description: Composed display name (build name + re-run/manual suffix + #serialId).

ciBuildData.description: CI context (best-effort; empty when CI info absent).

smartTagSettings.description: The smart-tag settings resolved for this run from its build's setting version.

ObsGenericLog.description: A single log/step/failure entry. Serialized with NON_NULL, so null fields are omitted. Sourced from GenericLog in observability-api.

ObsSessionLogs.description: Per-channel session-log descriptor map. Serialized with NON_NULL, so only channels with data appear. In get_test_run_log_urls each present channel is a URL/descriptor rather than inlined content. Sourced from SessionLogs in observability-api.

ObsSessionVideo.description: Session video descriptor with playback offsets. Sourced from SessionVideo in observability-api.

startOffset.description: ms offset of video start relative to the test/session, for aligning playback with the log timeline.

ObsHistoryTab.description: One past execution of the same test across builds. Sourced from HistoryTab in observability-api; startedAt is used for ordering and is not serialized.

testRunId.description: Integer id of the historical run (serialized from the internal Id field).

TestRunHistoryEntry.description: One test run's (or hook run's) execution-history entry from get_test_runs_history_details. Only the keys present for that run appear.

TestRunRetryLogStruct.description: Serialized log/attachment structure for a run or retry attempt. Each key is present only when that evidence exists.

TEST_FAILURE.description: Failure backtrace (the `backtrace` of the first failure log).

TEST_LOG.description: Screenshot / attachment URLs; fetch each directly from storage (not proxied through this API).

BROWSERSTACK_ERROR.description: BrowserStack-side error log, when the run failed on infra.

TestRunSdkLogEntry.description: One test run in a build that has SDK-captured logs/attachments.

url.description: Direct attachment/log URL, fetched from storage.

TestRunCountEntry.description: Per-unique-test rerun count within a build.

testHash.description: Stable hash identifying the unique test across runs.

count.description: Number of times the test ran across the build and its re-runs.

isDifferentPlatformsUsed.description: True when those runs spanned more than one platform.

TestRunIssueType.description: A failure category (issue type or sub-type) as returned on test-run endpoints.

locator.description: Stable locator code for the issue type (e.g. a category code).

issueGroup.description: Parent issue group (opaque; carries the group/enum this type sits under).

BuildSmartTestSelectionReport.description: Smart Test Selection report envelope. @JsonInclude(NON_NULL): null fields are omitted; terminal statuses (not-run/pending/failed) return a minimal envelope with most fields absent.

status.description: not-run | pending | ready | partial | failed | awaiting-execution | no-report.

mode.description: relevantOnly or relevantFirst; null until TCS returns it.

valueSummary.description: Populated only for relevantOnly + ready builds.

inputs.description: Repo-scoped inputs block (mode + repos[] with PRs/direct-pushes) for the header card.

tests.description: Test rows for the requested tab; each row: gitTestCaseId, testCaseName, filePath, status (selected|prioritized|not_selected), confidenceScore, reason[], source (agent|file-level|none), execution{state,result,isFlaky}, forced, badge, forceInclude[].

partialDataBanner.description: Banner copy for partial status only.

BuildSelfHealingReportUrl.description: Presigned URL for a build's self-healing report plus authoring/quota context. Built inline as a map by the handler.

presignedUrl.description: Expiring S3 GET URL for the self-healing report artefact.

groupUsesAuthoring.description: Whether the group uses the Authoring Agent. Present on this internal route only.

healingQuota.description: Best-effort healing quota; OMITTED entirely when the product/CAD or quota lookup fails.

BuildTopErrorStatsPanel.description: InsightStatsPanel for a build's top unique errors.

overview.description: Defaults to the 'Analysis yet to run' overview when analysis has not completed.

data.description: Error clusters sorted by count desc; each: id, title (the error), count, impactedTests, testRuns[], aiRcaTestRunIds[]. Empty while clustering is incomplete.

ready.description: False while the auto-analyser is still running.

message.description: Set (e.g. 'Unique Errors are being detected') when not ready; the only meaningful field in the not-ready state.

uuid.description: The resolved build uuid, or null (with HTTP 200) when nothing matched.

SidebarBuildRuns.description: A page of unique build runs for the sidebar rail with bidirectional cursor paging.

data.description: SidebarBuildSummary rows: uuid, id, name, originalName, normalisedName, status, displayStatus, startedAt, finishedAt, buildNumber, tags[], isArchived, usageQuotaStatus (retention vs pro-quota), qualityGateStatus, creationType, statusStats, source, selfHealedCount, etc.

TriggerBuildRerun.description: Result of a build re-run trigger. created=false with populated CI fields is the frontend-fallback signal, not an error.

created.description: Whether the CI re-run was triggered server-side.

username.description: CI username; populated on the fallback path so the FE can trigger the CI itself. Null on the Maestro/App-Automate direct path.

authToken.description: CI auth token for the fallback path.

paramUrl.description: CI URL to fetch current build params (fallback path).

buildUrl.description: CI URL to trigger the build (fallback path).

BuildQualityGateRecalcAck.description: Acknowledgement that quality-gate recalculation was queued (QualityGateSummary with only message set).

message.description: 'Quality Gate result will be available after recalculation finishes'.

BuildReportPolling.description: BuildReport polling envelope (@JsonInclude NON_NULL). May be a NULL body when the build cannot be resolved.

retryCount.description: How many more times to poll (present with IN_PROGRESS).

pollingInterval.description: Interval to wait before the next POLL request.

BuildHistoryWithDefectCounts.description: Agent-facing build history: anchor build + prior same-name runs, each with status and defect count summaries.

builds.description: Newest first; each entry: buildUuid, buildNumber (serialId), originalName, status, startedAt, finishedAt, durationMs, current (true for the anchor build), statusStats{passed,failed,skipped,total}, defectStats{automationBug,productBug,toBeInvestigated,notDetermined,environmentIssue}, flakyCount, alwaysFailingCount, newFailureCount.

PublicBuildDetails.description: Public build record. SHAPE IS FEATURE-FLAGGED (legacy BuildDetails vs BuildDetailsV2 when new build listing is enabled) and pro-only fields are JsonView-gated, so the exact key set varies by flag and plan. Representative top-level fields listed.

smart_tags.description: Pro-only; stripped by JsonView for non-pro plans.

DeleteBuildAck.description: Acknowledgement that build deletion was queued (async downstream).

Unauthorized.description: 401 - no valid credential was accepted by the authenticator chain.

Forbidden.description: 403 - authenticated but lacks the required permission/plan/role, or access-denied.

BadRequest.description: 400 - invalid or missing parameters; also the catch-all for many client errors.

NotFound.description: 404 - the addressed resource does not exist or is not visible to this group.

InternalServerError.description: 500 - unhandled server error; carries only errorTraceId + message.

UnprocessableEntity.description: 422 - the request was well-formed but semantically rejected.

Conflict.description: 409 - the request conflicts with current state, e.g. an operation already in progress.

UpdatedStringResponse.description: A plain-text body (the literal string "Updated"/"updated"), NOT a JSON object.

CITriggersListResponse.description: List of the group-visible CI triggers.

CITriggerResponse.description: A single CI trigger at the top level (no wrapper).

CITriggerSecretsListResponse.description: List of the group-visible CI-trigger secrets (values omitted).

CITriggerSecretResponse.description: A single CI-trigger secret at the top level (value omitted).

CITriggerResolveResponse.description: The resolved/effective request a trigger would send. Credential-disclosure: resolvedSecrets is decoded plaintext for any visible-trigger caller; the stored tokens are plaintext for the owner only, null otherwise.

resolvedUrl.description: Webhook URL with [SECRET] placeholders substituted and URL-encoded.

resolvedSecrets.description: Map of referenced secret name to its DECODED plaintext value. Returned to any caller who can see the trigger.

jenkinsApiToken.description: Decoded stored Jenkins token in plaintext; non-null only for the trigger's owner.

authToken.description: Decoded stored auth token in plaintext; non-null only for the trigger's owner.

CITriggerExecuteResponse.description: Result of firing a trigger. The API's own HTTP status is always 200; the CI system's outcome is inside this body.

statusCode.description: The remote CI system's HTTP status code; or 400 when the URL was blocked by the security validator, or 500 on any other internal failure.

responseBody.description: Raw response body from the CI system, or a generic 'Failed to execute CI trigger' message on a local block/failure.

IntegrationScoreResponse.description: The org's integration health score and per-category preferences.

BooleanResultResponse.description: A bare JSON boolean (true on success).

IntegrationSetupStatusResponse.description: Setup status. When connected: {"setup_completed": true}. When not connected: a 200 with a null body (NOT {"setup_completed": false}).

IntegrationAccessTokenResponse.description: A JSON-ENCODED STRING body that, when parsed, yields {access_token, expires_at, success}. On upstream auth failure the string is "{}"; in demo-sandbox it is an empty string.

UserIntegrationResponse.description: The user's stored credential for one integration, or a null body when not configured. authToken is plaintext.

EmailPreferencesWithProjectsResponse.description: Legacy email preferences: a map keyed by email-type name to {isSubscribed, projects[]}.

EmailPreferencesWithRuleCountsResponse.description: Newer email preferences: a map keyed by notification-type name (or COMMENT_EMAIL) to {isSubscribed, ruleCount}.

UsersEmailSubscriptionsResponse.description: Bulk per-user email subscription flags: a map keyed by numeric user id, each value a map of notification-type name to subscribed boolean.

EmailPreferenceDetailResponse.description: Per-project notification detail. Always the four keys DAILY_SUMMARY, BUILD_INSIGHTS, ALERTS, TEST_FAILURE, each mapping to a list of per-project preferences.

NotificationPreferenceResponse.description: Recipient list for one channel plus overall enabled flag.

NotificationSummaryResponse200.description: One notifier's full subscription config (the object is returned directly; empty/absent when NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND is thrown instead).

MyEmailNotificationResponse.description: Caller's own email subscription for one type. Conditional shape: {notifierId, notification} on success, or {notifierId:null, message} when no notifier/notification exists (both HTTP 200).

ProjectAlertsResponse.description: Top-level array of the project's latest alert definitions.

NotificationLogsResponse.description: Home notification feed page; empty payload (nulls) when the feature is off for the group.

BuildAggregateMapResponse.description: Top-level object keyed by build name; each value is a BuildAggregate.

EmailPreferenceResponse.description: Project email-notification config with per-user preferences.

ValidEmailsResponse.description: Resolved in-group users for the submitted emails.

PublicLinkSettingResponse.description: Public-link on/off setting for a dashboard or project. Built inline by the handler; defaults to false when no token row exists yet.

publicLink.description: Whether public link sharing is enabled. false is the default for a dashboard/project that has never been shared.

PublicLinkTokenResponse.description: The shareable public-link token for a dashboard or project report page (get-or-create). Serialised with non-null inclusion, so absent fields are simply omitted.

token.description: Opaque share credential, not a URL. The token is created enabled on first fetch.

PublicLinkSettingUpdated.description: Success body for enabling/disabling a public-link setting. This is the PLAIN-TEXT string `updated` (Content-Type text/plain), NOT a JSON object.

PublicLinkTokenValidation.description: Result of validating a public-link token. Conditional shape: userId and groupId are present only when isValid is true; an invalid/unknown token returns only isValid=false.

userId.description: Present only when isValid is true.

groupId.description: Present only when isValid is true.

StatusBadgeKeyResponse.description: The minted status-badge key (signed JWT). Serialised with non-null inclusion.

badge_key.description: Signed JWT bearer credential embedded in the public badge image / build-redirect URLs. Not stored server-side and not revocable.

QualityGateSettings.description: A project's quality-gate settings and mapped profiles.

QualityProfileDetail.description: One quality profile in full (rules, filters, status). Null fields omitted.

ProfileMutationResult.description: Result of creating or editing a profile. An edit returns a NEW uuid (the profile is versioned).

uuid.description: The profile's UUID. For an edit this is a freshly minted UUID that replaces the one addressed in the path.

BuildQualityGateSummary.description: Readiness-aware build gate summary; exactly one of qgResult/message/state is present.

BuildQualityProfileResults.description: Bare JSON array of per-profile result summaries for a build (no wrapper).

BuildQualityProfileResultDetail.description: One profile's per-rule results for a build.

CiQualityGateResult.description: CI-facing pass/fail quality gate result for a build. Null fields omitted while running.

QualityProfileFilterValues.description: Filter values for the quality-profile filter builder, with an afterKey cursor.

PercentTimelineCardResponse.description: A Testing Trends card: timeline series plus optional headline insight.

FailureCategoriesResponse.description: Failure counts broken down by defect category over time.

CbtResponse.description: Cross-browser coverage: primary platform groups plus their drill-down breakdowns.

id.description: Primary group key this drill-down belongs to.

BuildFrequencyResponse.description: Run counts per build name for the window. sourceFencingFlags exists on the model but is not populated on this path.

BuildNamesResponse.description: Distinct build names within the plan retention window, wrapped under data.

StabilityLeaderboardResponse.description: Paged stability leaderboard. Pagination is nested under `pagingParam` (singular).

PerformanceLeaderboardResponse.description: Paged performance leaderboard. Pagination is nested under `pagingParam` (singular).

StabilityChartResponse.description: Stability-over-time series with the window median.

median.description: Overall pass-rate percentage for the window.

PerformanceChartResponse.description: Performance-over-time: barData is average duration per bucket, lineData is test count per bucket (lineData points omit pointRange).

RecentRunsResponse.description: Recent builds picker. Pagination is nested under `pagingParams` (plural).

GroupAccessResponse.description: Raw CPM access record for the group and product test_observability, relayed unchanged from the upstream BrowserStack CPM API. Shape is owned upstream and opaque to TRA.

GroupTeamsListResponse.description: Bare array of the group's teams. Empty on any resolution error or when team access is disabled for the group.

GroupUsersListResponse.description: Bare array of users (group or sub-group listing). Not wrapped in an object. On the group listing, emails are blanked when a public-link token is present.

GroupUsersSearchResponse.description: Searchable/paginated group-users listing: users under `data`, cursor metadata under `pagingParams` (which may be absent on the last page).

InviteUsersResponse.description: Invite outcome. `message` is a human-readable summary; `invite_api_data` carries the per-address detail (null when the caller lacks invite permission). Returned on 200 (success), 400 (validation failure or partial success) and 500 (backend failure) alike — read `message`, not just the status.

InviteLinkResponse.description: The group's shareable invite link. On failure the body may instead be a plain error string, not this object.

ServiceSuccessResponse.description: Acknowledgement returned by the service-to-service identity endpoints.

message.description: Present only on the offboarding response shape; omitted by the sync/expire acknowledgements.

WebhookRuleListResponse.description: Webhook rule listing. `info` is present only when the caller sent a page (unpaginated legacy shape omits it).

info.description: Omitted entirely on the unpaginated (no-page) response.

WebhookRuleDetailResponse.description: Full webhook rule definition; fields at top level, no data wrapper.

WebhookCreateResponse.description: Create acknowledgement — does not echo the rule. Take the uuid.

WebhookUpdateResponse.description: Update acknowledgement — does not echo the rule.

WebhookOperationCompletion.description: Fixed completion message. Toggle returns {message:"Updated"}; delete returns {message:"Deleted"}.

WebhookTestResponse.description: Result of a webhook test call. ALWAYS HTTP 200 even on failure: a failed target is reported as {isError:true, statusCode:500, response:<message>}. Check isError, not the HTTP status.

response.description: The target's response body, or the failure message on error.

statusCode.description: The target's status code (500 on a caught failure).

isError.description: True when the test failed; the only reliable success/failure signal.

WebhookProjectMappingResponse.description: Project picker / mapping list for the webhook editor.

AISessionTokenResponse.description: AI session token, enabled features and TFA enablement.

PresignedUploadResponse.description: Presigned S3 upload credential (URL, form fields, key, expiry).

RcaRetriggerResponse.description: New RCA conversation turn id (and trial quota for trial users).

CodeFixPreferenceResponse.description: Saved AI code-fix guidance for a project + build name.

RcaAttachmentDownloadUrlResponse.description: Short-lived presigned GET URL for an RCA-context attachment (not the bytes).

WorkflowCallbackAckResponse.description: Acknowledgement that the workflow nudge was relayed.

BuildCloseAcknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement that the build was closed; the quality-gate evaluation runs asynchronously.

SimilarTestRunsResponse.description: Reference run and the runs with a similar failure.

BuildAuthoringReportUrlResponse.description: Presigned URL (and expiry) for the Authoring Agent report.

BuildAISummaryResponse.description: AI-generated build failure summary; soft-fails with status NOT_AVAILABLE.

BuildAlertsResponse.description: Alerts raised for the build and whether any are configured.

BuildAttemptRunStatsResponse.description: Per-attempt result breakdown plus an aggregate summary.

BuildHistoryResponse.description: Trend over the ~10 most recent builds of the same name.

BuildIdFromCoordinatesResponse.description: The resolved build UUID for the given coordinates.

BuildCoordinatesResponse.description: URL-safe coordinates and project ids for a build UUID.

BuildOptimizationResponse.description: Smart Test Selection / orchestration widget data; null fields omitted.

BuildReRunResponse.description: Flat (legacy) re-run summary for a build.

BuildReRunV2Response.description: Split-build-aware grouped re-run summary with an aggregate.

FieldSearchResponse.description: Type-ahead facet options for a per-project build filter. `data` is a set of {id, value, label} option objects.

SidebarSearchResponse.description: Sidebar facet options. `data` is a list of BARE VALUES — plain strings for branches, build names and tags. Capped at 100 entries by the underlying ES aggregation.

BuildListFiltersResponse.description: Per-project build-listing filter bar: applied selection resolved plus the static option catalogue.

BuildSidebarFiltersResponse.description: Cross-project build-listing sidebar filters: applied selection resolved (with the projects it was scoped to) plus the static option catalogue. frameworkList here is the hardcoded master list, not a per-project presence list.

projects.description: The project ids this filter view was scoped to.

BuildTestFiltersResponse.description: Filter panel for a build's TEST listing. `staticFilters` is a map keyed by filter name to a list of {label, value} options. `proFilters` names plan-locked filter keys (non-empty only for freemium).

applied.description: The caller's applied test filters, echoed back resolved (folders, testTags, status, priority, caseType, automationStatus, owner, lastExecutedBy, deviceList, osList, browserList, failureCategories, dateRange, and the boolean history/flaky flags).

staticFilters.description: Catalogue of selectable test-filter values, keyed by filter name (browserList, osList, status, testTags, folders, runs, deviceList, failureCategories, history, flaky, ...).

hooksVisibility.description: One of all / failed / beforeFailed / none.

proFilters.description: Filter keys locked behind a paid plan; empty for a paid workspace, else names keys like isFlaky, isNewFailure, isAlwaysFailing, hasPerformanceAnomaly, isMuted.

RunGroupFilterOptionsResponse.description: Run-group (build-group) sidebar facet. `data` is a list of full build-group objects; `info` is page metadata but paging is fixed at page 1, size 100 and cannot be advanced through this endpoint.

items.description: Build group: id, name, description, projectId, groupId, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt, isClosed, closedAt, closedBy, closedByName.

DashboardDeleteResponse.description: Delete acknowledgement. Body is the JSON object {"success": true} serialized as a string.

UniqueErrorSearchResponse.description: Top-level JSON array of unique-error search hits (max 10). There is no wrapper object.

WidgetCustomFieldFiltersResponse.description: Custom-field filters. Shape depends on the request: with NO page/per_page/search it is a bare JSON ARRAY of FilterDetails; with any of them it is the paginated object {data, info}.

oneOf.description: Unpaginated: returned when page/per_page/search are all omitted.
Paginated: returned when any of page/per_page/search is present.

ReportListResponse.description: Reports/dashboards listing. On an invalid `source` this same 200 carries a top-level `error` string and empty `data`.

error.description: Present only on the invalid-source 200 refusal.

ProjectAutomationCoverageResponse.description: All-time automation-coverage figures for one project. Null fields are omitted (NON_NULL).

ProjectListingExternalResponse.description: One page (10) of the caller's projects, plus the cursor for the next page.

HomeUniqueBuildsResponse.description: Latest runs grouped by unique build name, with dual offset/cursor pagination params.

data.description: One BuildSummary per unique build name (its most recent run).

afterKey.description: search_after cursor to carry into the next request.

HomeTakeawaysResponse.description: Older Home takeaways variant: aggregate time-saved metric. The v2 timeSavingV2Metric field is absent on this path.

HomeTakeawaysNoiseBreakdownResponse.description: Newer Home takeaways variant: failure-noise breakdown. timeSavingsData is explicitly null on this path.

PlanDetailsResponse.description: The group's plan details (also embedded as planDetails inside the app-bootstrap response).

type.description: Plan type; TRA-Essentials is reported as paid here.

canClaimFreeTrial.description: True only when the group has neither requested nor acquired the extended trial.

features.description: Per-feature entitlement map; each value has isMetered/isActive, and metered features add total/used.

InitUserAccessDetailsResponse.description: App-bootstrap payload. Built as an ObjectNode; keys below are always set unless noted.

accessDetails.description: Access flags; legacy permission keys are merged in when globalRBAC is on.

subGroupId.description: -1 when the user has no sub-group.

isMyBuilds.description: Defaults to true when the user has no saved filters.

GetAccessResponse.description: Whitelist opt-in result. Returned with HTTP 200 on success and HTTP 403 when the group was already whitelisted (success=false); body shape is identical.

CreateProjectResponse.description: Raw JSON string body carrying the (new or existing) observability project id.

ProjectBuildGroupListingResponse.description: A project's builds consolidated by build group, plus per-group aggregates and cursor pagination.

searchAfter.description: Cursor (array or integer) to carry into the next request.

AlertTypeListResponse.description: Bare JSON array of subscribable alert types.

GlobalSettingsResponse.description: Account-wide build-visibility settings. An empty excluded_sources can mean 'nothing excluded' OR an upstream read failure.

UserPreferenceResponse.description: The signed-in user's preferences, wrapped under data. Rewritten per product, so may differ from what was saved.

IssueSubTypeCreatedResponse.description: Created failure-category sub-type: its integer id and string locator.

locator.description: String id used to reference this sub-type in later updates.

ProjectSettingsResponse.description: Project settings page payload: sub-types grouped by parent issue type, alerts grouped by alert type.

subTypes.description: Map: parent issue type → list of IssueSubTypeResource.

alerts.description: Map: alert type → list of AlertResource.

SettingsResponseV2.description: Newer-surface write acknowledgement. Note `id` is a STRING.

AlertNotifierListResponse.description: Bare JSON array of available notification targets (enabled, non-conditional, unattached notifiers).

UntypedSettingsResponse.description: Untyped flat settings map (setting-key → string value); every expected key present, defaults filled in. Keys are not fixed by this contract.

AutoCloseSettingsResponse.description: Project auto-close policy. When unset: {enabled:false} with thresholdDays/enabledAt absent.

enabledAt.description: Epoch SECONDS the policy was enabled; anchors the 7-day grace window. Null when disabled.

projectsConfigured.description: Only populated on a write; null/absent on read.

RcaConversationTurnResponse.description: A single RCA conversation turn. In the build flow threadId/threadTitle/userAction are populated; in the test-run flow they are null.

TestRcaConversationListResponse.description: Test-run RCA conversation history: a bare JSON array of turns, oldest-first, no envelope. threadId/threadTitle/userAction are null on every element.

BuildRcaConversationListResponse.description: Cursor-paginated page of one build thread's turns (from ListBuildRcaConversationResponse).

nextCursor.description: ISO-8601 createdAt of the oldest row in this page; pass back as ?cursor= for the next older page. Null at the end of history.

BuildRcaThreadResponse.description: A single build-level RCA chat thread.

BuildRcaThreadListResponse.description: The caller's build RCA chat threads, most-recently-active first: a bare JSON array, no envelope. Empty array when none.

narration_kickoff_fired.description: Whether a terminal state actually triggered the narration kickoff.

RcaChatTurnAckResponse.description: Acknowledgement for a submitted public rcaChat turn (from RcaChatTurnResponse). Fields are omitted when null.

turnId.description: Opaque turn id to poll (a Redis result key, not a UUID messageId).

RcaChatTurnStatusResponse.description: Polled status of a public rcaChat turn (from RcaChatStatusResponse). Fields are omitted when null.

turn.description: The structured LLM-enforced TurnResponse when ready: turn.status + confidence + a per-status sub-object (needs_info/blocked, or the stitched rca for RESOLVED). message_id and confidence live inside this object.

RcaRetriggerResponse__w2_rca_conversatio.description: Retry acknowledgement (from RetriggerResponse). Only messageId is set on the retry path; trialQuota is populated only by the retrigger flow.

messageId.description: The same turn id that was retried.

trialQuota.description: Present only on the retrigger flow, not on retry.

SPTestFilterOptions.description: Suite Health test-list filter sidebar: the applied filters resolved into display fields, the static option catalogue, and the project default hooks visibility.

applied.description: The currently applied filters, each resolved into Field objects (buildTags, uniqueBuildNames, folders, testTags, status, hostNames, users, lastExecutedBy, teams, failureCategories, deviceList/osList/browserList, branches, pmToolStatus) plus scalar/tri-state flags (search, isFlaky, isNewFailure, isAlwaysFailing, hasPmToolDefects, isManuallyOverridden, isCiRun, isLatest), a dateRange, isMuted and hooksVisibility.

staticFilters.description: The choosable option catalogue: osList, browserList, deviceList, status, folders, failureCategories, pmToolStatus, customMetaData, sources, lastExecutedBy, typeOfRun, assignedTo, state, testPlan — each a set of Field objects. The run-level lists (typeOfRun, assignedTo, state, testPlan) come from an upstream service and are EMPTY on upstream timeout rather than erroring.

hooksVisibility.description: The project's default hooks visibility (all / failed / beforeFailed / none).

FieldSearchResults.description: A set of filter suggestions/options. Shared by the branch, build-name, build-tag, host-name and test-tag type-ahead routes.

data.description: Suggestion items (deduplicated set).
